blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Corrected 2026-08-08 at Ethereum block 25712116. The EIP-1967 implementation slot still resolved to Sourcify-verified sGho implementation 0xff229a0bbb614a284de8ae0e41e5974878fd7c04. Its pause() and unpause() entrypoints are gated by PAUSE_GUARDIAN_ROLE, and its ERC-20 _update override is whenNotPaused, so pausing blocks holder transfers, deposits, withdrawals, mints, and burns. paused() was false and hasRole(PAUSE_GUARDIAN_ROLE, 0x5300a1a15135ea4dc7ad5a167152c01efc9b192a) was true at the observation block. This is a live direct system-wide transfer-freeze mechanism, not only inherited GHO exposure.

oracleRisk.summary: sGHO is an ERC-4626 savings wrapper over GHO and has no borrower-owned collateral positions or token-level liquidation engine. Its underlying GHO exposure inherits the external Aave reserve-oracle risk reviewed on the parent asset.

branchApplicability.rationale: Aave documents sGHO as a savings vault where users deposit GHO and withdraw GHO against an accruing share value. sGHO holders do not open Aave borrower positions, so there are no sGHO collateral-market or liquidation branches to inventory; the underlying GHO parent carries the separate Aave oracle profile.
